content.value: Suppose a TCP message that contains 2048 bytes of data and 20 bytes of TCP header (15) [CO3] is passed to IP for delivery across two networks of the Internet (i.e., from the source host to a router to the destination host). The first network uses 14 bytes header and has an MTU of 1024 bytes; the second network uses 8 bytes header with an MTU of 512 bytes. Give the sizes and offsets of the sequence of fragments delivered to the network layer at the destination host. Assume all IP headers are 20 bytes.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2024
